rationale: With 44 minutes to close and price sitting at 78.5% of today's range near $35.10–$35.16, the last five 1-minute candles show a very tight, low-volatility grind upward with minimal range (each candle spanning only a few cents), suggesting momentum is fading rather than accelerating. The ATR of $0.12 on 5-minute bars leaves little room for a favorable risk/reward setup before forced liquidation at close, and the spread cost plus execution slippage would consume a meaningful portion of any realistic move. Given the already negative realized P&L today and the unfavorable reward-to-risk profile this late in the session, no trade is warranted.
